text:
maria: kicking off FP8 kernel canary on one H100 + one L40S for atlas-13b (AWQ and GPTQ variants). low-risk window 30m. tagging @ajay for observability.
ajay: thanks. what are the exact config flags you enabled? want to wire up traces + token-level diffs early.
maria: running with --enable-fp8-kernel=true --mixed-precision=auto --kv-tiling=legacy for the canary. canary model ids: atlas13b-awq-v2, atlas13b-gptq-v3.
kevin: noted. suggest setting QC hooks: token_diff, log_ppl_delta, and sample_prompts from evalset-regen-2026.
sasha: quick heads up: in a small run earlier we saw softmax blowups on long context (512+) for AWQ on L40S. fallback triggered and returned INT8 path which looked fine but introduced token distribution drift.
maria: exact. AWQ on L40S triggered precision-fallback at step ~120 due to activation-scale exceeding threshold. GPTQ path stayed stable.
ajay: can you paste the short snippet of the log around the fallback?
maria: ```
[2026-03-19T14:03:21Z] kernel(fp8): activation_scale: 18.2 > threshold(16.0) -> triggering fp8_fallback
[2026-03-19T14:03:21Z] runtime: swapped to int8_gemm variant, kv_cache_relayout=true
[2026-03-19T14:03:22Z] eval: sample 7/20 token divergence at token 14 -> bleu_delta -3.4
```
kevin: that relayout + swapping path is the likely culprit for alignment mismatch. when fallback happens mid-sequence the KV layout differs and the model sees drift.
sasha: we should avoid mid-sequence fallback if possible. options: increase threshold, enable pre-scale clipping, or prefer stable-gemm fallback that preserves KV layout.
ajay: agree. for the canary let's add `--fp8-fallback-mode=deferred` (delay until sequence end) and `--fp8-preclip=8.0` to reduce spikes. Also add a canary-only metric: percent_sequences_with_fallback.
maria: applied both flags on H100 and L40S canaries. redeployed at 14:22 UTC. deploy-bot started canary rollout.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started: 2 hosts (host-h100-03, host-l40s-07). monitor: /dash/canaries/2140036789
kevin: small experiment idea: compare AWQ-permute vs AWQ-no-permute kernels; sometimes permute ops increase instantaneous activation norms. run A/B comparing permute_on=true/false.
sasha: also add a short prompt set stressing long-term dependencies (role-play long context + math). AWQ had bigger deltas there in prior tests.
maria: initial 5m smoke: H100 AWQ had one seq with fallback (deferred prevented mid-seq swap), L40S AWQ had 3 seqs where deferred still needed fallback at seq-end. GPTQ had zero fallbacks.
ajay: what's token-delta distribution for AWQ vs GPTQ after deferred fallback patch?
maria: summary: AWQ mean token-divergence=0.9 tokens/sample, GPTQ=0.2. AWQ tail (95th)=4 tokens. PPL delta AWQ vs baseline = +0.14 on conversational evalset; GPTQ +0.03.
kevin: those numbers map to moderate quality regression for AWQ in generative tasks. cost-wise AWQ still wins but need to decide SLA tolerance.
sasha: can we toggle activation clamping per-layer? some layers spike due to rotary scaling. adding per-layer clip seems to help in offline runs.
maria: added per-layer clamp heuristics to canary config (`layer_clamp_map=4:12.0,10:9.0`) and restarted L40S AWQ canary.
ajay: can we capture KV snapshots pre- and post-fallback for one sequence to diff bytewise? that'll verify layout mismatch theory.
maria: added KV snapshot hook for one traced request. will attach when available.
deploy-bot: canary health: host-h100-03 healthy (0 fallbacks), host-l40s-07 degraded (3 fallbacks, token-delta spikes). dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/canaries/2140036789
kevin: next steps proposal:
- stop expanding AWQ canary until we get fallback rate <0.5% and 95th token-delta <2
- push per-layer clamp + preclip as default for AWQ on L40S
- run AWQ permute toggle A/B for 1h
- add KV byte-diff tool to infra
sasha: +1. I'll take permute A/B and KV diff tool pairing.
ajay: I'll update canary runbook and alert thresholds. set Pager if fallback_rate>1% for 10m.
maria: thanks. saving runbook notes to EvalOps and will paste link when done. for now holding AWQ expansion. :thumbsup:
kevin: thanks everyone. good find on deferred-fallback mode, saved us from worse drift.
maria: attaching final quick logs for archive: ```
AWQ_l40s_run1.log: fallback_count=3, mean_token_delta=1.8, 95th=4
GPTQ_h100_run1.log: fallback_count=0, mean_token_delta=0.2, 95th=1
``` 
maria: will follow up tomorrow with KV diffs and updated perf/cost tradeoffs.
